question: How many children received the Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar 2022, award from PM Narendra Modi on National girl child day?
solution:
The correct answer is __**29**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Twenty-Nine** Children have been selected for the **Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar.**
 
• In the current year, The candidates are selected from all regions of the country for their exceptional achievements in the field of Innovation (7), Social Service (4), Scholastic (1), Sports (8), Art & Culture (6) and Bravery (3) categories.
 
• These **Awards** are given as an appreciation to **individuals** who have shown an **outstanding contribution** towards service for children in the field of **Child Development, Child Protection, and Child Welfare** for more than **7 years** and have created a positive impact on the lives of children.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **​ National Girl Child Day **

 
 
• It is celebrated on **24 January** to spread awareness about the obstacles faced by girls in Indian society.
 
• It is also celebrated for promoting awareness about the rights of the girl child and the importance of female education, health, and nutrition.
 
• The theme for National Girl Child Day 2023 is Digital Generation, Our Generation.
